scenes.title: 타격 순간을 기억하는 이유
lines: In Tekken, Lili raises one foot above her head. The move is over in an instant, but the diagonal from her supporting leg to her foot sticks in your mind. Hit stop briefly freezes the action when an attack connects. It gives the contact pose more time on screen. That’s why it helps to pose that one frame first, using an articulated figure or a character model. We’ll adjust its size, direction and asymmetry, then check the silhouette.

scenes.title: 멀리서 읽히는 크기
lines: At the wide camera distance in Super Smash Bros., tiny changes at the wrist get lost. Shrink the pose to its actual size during play. A slight reach and a lean extending from shoulder to foot read differently at that size. What counts is whether you can read the direction of the force.

scenes.title: 멋진 자세가 상대를 지나가야 한다
lines: Even a handsome pose can send the attack past the target. A hand can overlap the target from the side yet miss it in a top view. In our study, a line marks the plane shared by the fighters. Watch the same punch from the side and then from above. Even when exaggerating the silhouette, the fist must pass through the right space.

scenes.title: 몸의 양쪽에 다른 역할 주기
lines: Once the direction works, give the two sides of the body different jobs. One arm strikes while the other balances the body. Offsetting the shoulders from the hips reveals how the torso unwinds. With a character like Donkey Kong, those broad shoulders and arms make the difference easy to see. Conversely, when Wario throws both arms wide in an expression, symmetry can be the point.

scenes.title: 어느 순간에 멈추는가
lines: Now choose the instant to freeze. The left freezes just before extension; the right holds a later, more extended pose. Freezing too early makes the same trajectory look as if it fell short. The great sword in Monster Hunter reads most clearly when you see the blade and the target react together. You can test which pose to hold for hit stop even after the animation is built.

scenes.title: 카메라 위치도 자세를 바꾼다
lines: The selected pose can change again through the gameplay camera. Perspective enlarges nearer parts, and the arm can overlap the torso. Put the same pose on the left and the right of the screen and check whether the limbs stay distinct. A pose that worked in the model view must still read in the game.

scenes.title: 윤곽만 남겨도 공격이 보이는가
lines: Remove color and surface detail and only the outer contour remains. That’s the silhouette. If both arms overlap the torso, losing the internal detail makes the action hard to identify. Turn the torso and separate the supporting leg to open clear gaps between the limbs. Then restore the materials and normal speed and check the attack direction again.

scenes.title: 좋은 자세를 고르는 눈
lines: This is why Lili’s opening kick stayed in your mind. One leg supported her while the other aimed at the target, so their roles remained distinct even at a distance. Start with the one pose you want viewers to remember, then check it through the gameplay camera. Check that it passes through the opponent and conveys the same force both when held and at normal speed.
